'''Tyler Thello''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Shortly before the [[Galactic War]], at the request of [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] [[Jun Seros (Jedi)|Jun Seros]], Tyler worked with [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Dhal]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] in an effort to capture the [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] responsible for the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kellian Jarro]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Thendys Noori]], and for the destruction of the Republic vessel [[Aurora (Valor-class)|''Aurora'']]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] was lured into a trap on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] by Dhal, and Thello led a strike team to capture the hunter, but the hunter killed Thello and the strike team and escaped.<ref name="Endorsement" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{GameDS}}
Tyler Thello appears as an enemy in the Bounty Hunter class mission "Endorsement" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. If players spared Thendys Noori, she will appear in Thello's place, but as the Bounty Hunter is an Imperial class and thus assumed to make the dark side choices, Thello is assumed to be present on Quesh.<ref name="Endorsement" />
